CERTIFICATION STATEMENT

I certify that I have read the contents of this application and that the information provided is true, accurate, and complete to the best of my knowledge. I understand that the intentional submission of false information may result in the revocation of my Medicare enrollment and may subject me to criminal, civil and/or administrative penalties.

I understand that upon submission of this enrollment application, if approved, I will be bound by the Medicare laws, regulations, and program instructions. I agree to abide by the Medicare laws, regulations, and program instructions, including but not limited to, applicable statutory and regulatory provisions of Titles XI and XVIII of the Social Security Act; 42 C.F.R. Parts 400, 424 and 498; and CMS program instructions, including those contained in applicable manuals.
